subject: general
question: Anthony starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards West. He takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left again and drives 13 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 2 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 deg)
solution:
Given:

Anthony starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards West.

He takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left again and drives 13 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 2 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23d3a28a6d9656bd810373f8bc95e8e5b5cdf9dcc1025db6f57b909f63ad3dcd.png] 

Thus, Anthony should drive (3 km + 2 km) 5 km in the north direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
